_comment: Per-tool run templates for entry.py. {model} = MCL_MODEL (validated), {brief_file} = copy of /out/brief on tmpfs, {work} = /work, {home} = $HOME. Flags marked UNVERIFIED come from newer CLI versions than the pins (plan1b-facts section 1) and must be confirmed with --help in the built image.

codex.unverified: danger-full-access chosen because Codex's own Linux sandbox may not start under cap-drop ALL; the container is the sandbox. Smoke S1 must confirm. Auth link survives token refresh only if codex rewrites auth.json in place (S9).

grok.unverified: All flags were checked on grok 1.0.52 only, not on the pinned 1.0.50: --no-auto-update, --no-alt-screen, --output-format streaming-json, --cwd, --always-approve, --sandbox off, --prompt-file. Run grok --help in the image. Session layout and whether model traffic honours HTTPS_PROXY are also UNVERIFIED.

pi.unverified: Flags checked on pi 1.3.0 docs only, not on the pinned 1.0.4. Model id form is runinfra/<id> as in the pi-delegate relay.
